You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def solve(g):
    pts_=pts(g); A,B=pts_[0],pts_[1]
    import copy; o=[r[:] for r in g]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=A[0],A[1],B[0],B[1]
    dr,dc=abs(r1-r0),abs(c1-c0)
    # assume dr>=dc; generalize below
    if dc>dr: r0,r1,c0,c1=c0,c1,r0,r1
    if (r1<r0)!= (c1<c0): swap=False
    else: swap=True
    if dc>dr:
        r0_,r1_=c0,c1; c0_,c1_=r0,r1
        dr,dc=dr,dc
        swapped=True
    # ensure dr>=dc
    if dc>dr: r0,r1,c0,c1=c0,c1,r0,r1; dr,dc=dc,dr
    # diagonal steps total = dc ; middle length dr-dc, along rows
    step=(1 if r1>r0 else -1)*(1 if c1>c0 else -1)
    rr=r0+c0 if False else None
    # build path starting after A
    r,c=A[0]+step[0]*0,A[1]
    # middle length m = dr-dc along row direction
    m=dr-dc
    r=A[0]; cells=[]
    diag_start=A
    if dr==dc:
        n=dr
        cells=[(r0+step[0]*i,c0+step[1]*i) for i in range(1,n)]
        cells.append(B)
    else:
        # first diag step
        cells=[(r+step[0],c+step[1])]
        # middle segment: m steps along row axis
        cells=[(r+step[0]+i*step[0], c+step[1]) for i in range(m)]
        # remaining diag steps: dc-m... total diag steps = dc; middle consumes 0 diag steps? 
        # actually middle travels along row axis only; diag steps remain dc
        rem=dc

    if abs(B[0]-A[0])>=abs(B[1]-A[1]):

for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    pts=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x!=0]
    # assume exactly two dots of colors a,b
    (r1,c1,a),(r2,c2,b)=pts
    col=3
    # diagonal from r1 toward c2, then straight to row adjacent to r2
    sr=1 if r2>r1 else -1
    sc=1 if c2>c1 else -1
    k=1
    while True:

        if nc==c2: break
        k+=1
    for kk in range(1,k+1): g[r1+sr*kk][c1+sc*kk]=col
    last=(r1+sr*k, c2)
    for rr in range(last[0]+sr, r2, sr): g[rr][c2]=col
    return g

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; pts=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x!=0]
    (r1,c1,_),(r2,c2,_)=(pts[0],pts[1]); col=3
    sgn=1 if c1<c2 else -1          # movement direction along columns
    corners=c2-sgn                  # last column before passing dot2 (demo: 3-(-1)=4)
    steps=abs(corners-c1)
    dr=1 if r2>r1 else -1
    for k in range(1,steps+1):      # diagonal: (r1+k, c1+sgn*k) reaches (8,4) when steps=7

    for rr in range(r1+dr*steps+1, r2):   # vertical leg at corner col down to just above dot2
        g[rr][corners]=col
    return g
print(f(G['Demo pair 4 input'])==G['Demo pair 4 output'])
